name: knowledge_graph
description: Build and audit a queryable method graph from a completed paper collection.

artifacts.description: MinerU Markdown, content-list layout records, middle/layout JSON, images, and checksums
PaperGraph Step 1 structures with upstream, Semantic Scholar, and local reference alignment
Three-pass, deterministically validated PaperGraph Step 2 LLM extractions
PaperGraph-compatible Paper, Core, Baseline, and Dataset nodes with grounded relations and static preview metadata
PaperGraph-compatible SQLite graph with wide node/edge columns, aliases, extraction records, indexes, and FTS
MinerU, PaperGraph, grounding, provenance, graph compatibility, SQLite, and FTS audit

arguments.name: --llm-disable-thinking
arguments.description: Disable thinking through chat_template_kwargs for compatible extraction models.

arguments.name: --mineru-device
arguments.description: Select CPU, CUDA, or an allocated Ascend NPU for parsing.

arguments.name: --mineru-batch-size
arguments.description: Maximum PDFs per worker batch; each completed batch is checkpointed.

arguments.name: --mineru-backend
arguments.description: Select the MinerU execution backend.

arguments.name: --mineru-method
arguments.description: Select automatic, text, or OCR parsing.

arguments.name: --mineru-language
arguments.description: Set the MinerU document language.

arguments.name: --gpu
arguments.description: Select a GPU index; repeat to select multiple devices.

arguments.name: --mineru-workers
arguments.description: Set MinerU worker count.

arguments.name: --mineru-timeout
arguments.description: Set the MinerU timeout in seconds.

arguments.name: --min-gpu-free-gb
arguments.description: Require minimum free GPU memory in GiB.

arguments.name: --max-gpu-utilization
arguments.description: Set maximum allowed GPU utilization percent.

arguments.name: --structure-workers
arguments.description: Set structure extraction workers.

arguments.name: --llm-workers
arguments.description: Set concurrent graph extraction LLM workers.

arguments.name: --llm-timeout
arguments.description: Set each graph extraction LLM timeout.

arguments.name: --llm-retries
arguments.description: Set graph extraction LLM retry count.

arguments.name: --llm-validation-retries
arguments.description: Set validation repair retry count.

arguments.name: --llm-rpm

arguments.description: Bound characters sent for each paper extraction.

arguments.name: --llm-max-output-tokens
arguments.description: Bound graph extraction output tokens.

arguments.description: Set the minimum paper count audit gate.

arguments.description: Set the minimum graph node audit gate.

arguments.description: Set the minimum graph edge audit gate.
